report.summary: Of the two claims checked, only revenue has external data — and it shows a meaningful 13.8% gap between the claimed $52.8B and SEC EDGAR's reported $46.4B for FY2026. This is a significant discrepancy from a high-credibility source and cannot be dismissed as a timing difference alone. The employee count claim could not be verified against any external data. News headlines suggest Nike is in a prolonged turnaround with investor patience wearing thin, consistent with the revenue shortfall narrative.
